notes.title: DirectX 10 Update Now On Beta Branch!
notes.notes:
Exciting news! The devs have been working on getting Yomawari up and running on older DirectX versions! Initially only available for DX11 and up, Yomawari should now be compatible with DX10! Hop on the Beta Branch of the game to see this in action. For those who don't know quite how to do that:

1) From your Steam Library, right click on Yomawari and select “Properties”
2) Go to the “BETAS” tab
3) Select the beta from the dropdown menu. This should start installing the beta version of Yomawari (no password required)

So if you were having any trouble running Yomawari before, try out the Beta Branch, and you just might find it working perfectly! But if there are still hiccups, please let us know in the Troubleshooting forum!

Don't get scared out there...
Alex
